book.name: 2 Kolinita
book.title: 2 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta heluwena Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Loina hauhauna weyahina
Togidega, ꞌabehega ꞌagwae gagasa mumugama ꞌausalana weyahina? Geyaꞌabwa. Ma hesi tomota tupwadi nuwanuwadi ꞌidi leta ꞌigwaeya,
Genuwama ꞌima letaina walele gidemusa, bo nuwana tomota hagadi ꞌima letao sileledi gidemusa.
Weyahina ꞌomi tuwa ꞌima letaowedi, ma tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌoimiyega sihasili, ma ꞌoinega ꞌimi mumuga ꞌausalana siꞌita ma ꞌima paihowa ꞌoimiya sida sanapu ꞌabehega ꞌausalana,

ma nage ꞌoinega waheꞌitadi ꞌabehega ꞌomi tuwa leta Keliso ꞌoinega, Yehoba tauna mayawasina Yaluyaluwanega ꞌileleya, geya ꞌebelele ꞌoinega, nuwana dimwa tabatabadi ꞌoidiya, ma hesi tomota ꞌatena, ma ꞌomi gide leta, ta ꞌaꞌebwayaegomiya tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiya.
Bewa weyahina Keliso ꞌina ꞌabihetenega ꞌaꞌatepatuwa Yehoba matana.
Geya ꞌabehega tauma weyahima ꞌagwaegwae hanehane ma ꞌagwae, “Tauma ꞌima bwebweꞌana ꞌoinega paihowa ꞌapaipaihowadi,” ma hesiyage Yehoba ꞌiboimo ꞌiꞌabiꞌabi hewaiwaiyemai,

ma sowasowahina ꞌina loina hauhauna weyahina ꞌahehetopaihowa. Loinaina hauhauna geya lelelelena, ma hesi Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌoinega, weyahina loina lelelelena ꞌamasa ꞌiꞌebwaegita, ma tuwa loinaina Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌoinega yawasida miyamiya hatayana ꞌiꞌebwaegita.

Ma loina miyamiyana ꞌamasa weyahina, ma dimwa tabatabadi ꞌoidiya silelediya ta Yehoba Mosese ꞌiꞌebwaeya, ꞌasilala madouna ꞌalona, ta Mosese manina ꞌoinega ꞌasilala ꞌisaesae ma tupwana ꞌimiya ꞌamana, ma ꞌoinega wete ꞌisawala, ma tutaina Mosese manina ꞌisaesae meIsileli geya sowasowahina ma siꞌebubu.
Coinega tasanapuya ꞌabehega loina hauhauna Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌoinega ꞌina wasawasa madou hedade ꞌasilalaina.
Loina miyamiyana ꞌoinega tomota yatala siloba ma hesi loina maꞌina wasawasa ꞌasiꞌasilalana. Loina hauhaunaina mumuga dumwaluna ꞌiꞌebwaegita ta ꞌina wasawasa ꞌasilala hedade.
Wete loina miyamiyana ꞌina ꞌasilala ꞌana ꞌita gide sawasawalina, ma hesi loina hauhauna ꞌina ꞌasilala bwebweꞌana hedade.
Loina miyamiyana geya ꞌida miyahataya, ma hesi ꞌasiꞌasilalana, ꞌoinega tasanapuya ꞌabehega loina hauhauna tauna miyamiya hatayana ma ꞌasilala hedade.
Tanuwatuhu yahiya ꞌabehega loina hauhauna ꞌoinega tabwebweꞌana hataya, ma weyahina taꞌatepatu,
ma Mosese geya gide tauda, weyahina Mosese manina ꞌasilalana nata ꞌisawala, ma ꞌiꞌahu ꞌauꞌausiya ta ꞌabehega sahena meIsileli siꞌitaꞌita.

Moisa, meIsileliyedi nuwa potapotadi, mwalohene ta nige, weyahina ꞌabwa tuwa bewa ꞌeguma loina miyamiyana ꞌana hasila sihesagohe, nuwadi sitala ꞌauꞌausidi ꞌidi nuwa potepotega, ma sahena sinuwanuwa sabwalena, ma Keliso ꞌiboimo sowasowahina talaꞌausina ꞌiꞌewa yahuledi.
Moisa, mwalohene ta nige ꞌeguma Mosese ꞌina loinao sihesagohedi, nuwadi sitalaꞌauꞌausidi ma geya sinuwa sabwelenidi,
ma hesi ꞌeguma ꞌaigeda taiya ꞌiꞌitahila ꞌida Badaina ꞌoina ꞌihemisa, beno talaꞌauꞌausina ꞌiꞌewayahule.
Ma Bada tauna Yaluyaluwa, ma Badaina Yaluyaluwana ꞌada tolihasa.

Coinega geya ꞌaigeda ꞌahubodaboda manida ꞌimiyamiya, ma Bada ꞌina wasawasa ꞌasiꞌasilalana ꞌoina taꞌeꞌebubuna, ta tupwana ma tupwana ꞌibuibuigita tauna ꞌana ꞌita ꞌasiꞌasilalana gide. Paihowa bewa Badaina ꞌoinega, tauna yaluyaluwa tuwa.
